source: Roark, Table 8.1 case 2a (cantilever, uniform load), plus shear
request:
Plan: a 300 x 30 x 10 mm bar (30 wide, 10 thick, lying flat), mild steel (steel_s235), fixed at the wall end (xmin). The 600 N of books is applied as a total force of 600 N down (-Z) over the top face. Hand check: a cantilever with uniform load deflects the same as an end load of 3/8 of the total, so I check against P = 225 N at the tip (exact textbook equivalent). Self-weight is ignored.

```bash
ea make beam length=300 width=30 height=10 --name "shelf bar"
ea analyze last -m steel_s235 --fix xmin --force zmax 0,0,-600 --check "beam.cantilever_end_load P=225 L=300 E=210GPa b=30 h=10 nu=0.3"
```

source: Roark, Table 8.1 case 1a with the hollow-section inertia (Table A.1), plus thin-wall shear
request:
Plan: square tube 40 x 40 mm, 3 mm wall, 600 mm long (beam template, rect_tube), Al 6061-T6, clamped at xmin, 500 N down (-Z) at the free end face. Hand check: the tube's second moment of area (about 101,970 mm^4) equals that of a 40 wide x 31.3 deep solid rectangle, so the cantilever formula is used with that equivalent section.

```bash
ea make beam length=600 width=40 height=40 section=rect_tube wall=3 --name "square tube"
ea analyze last -m al_6061_t6 --fix xmin --force xmax 0,0,-500 --check "beam.cantilever_end_load P=500 L=600 E=69GPa b=40 h=31.3 nu=0.33"
```

source: Roark, Table 11.2 case 10b (circular plate, fixed edge, uniform pressure)
request:
Plan: no template makes a round disc, so a short custom shape: 200 mm diameter, 5 mm thick, steel (steel_generic), outer rim clamped, 1 bar = 0.1 MPa pushing on the top face. Hand check: clamped circular plate under uniform pressure (plate.circular_uniform); the plate is thin relative to its diameter so the textbook result should be close.

```python
from build123d import *
from engagent.cad import params, save
P = params(diameter=200.0, thickness=5.0)
part = Pos(P.diameter / 2, P.diameter / 2, P.thickness / 2) * Cylinder(P.diameter / 2, P.thickness)
save(part)
```
```bash
ea make geometry.py --name "clamped disc"
ea analyze last -m steel_generic --fix cyl:100 --pressure zmax 0.1 --check "plate.circular_uniform p=0.1 a=100 t=5 E=210GPa nu=0.3 edge=clamped"
```

source: Euler buckling, pinned-pinned (K = 1): P_cr = pi^2 E I / L^2
request:
Plan: round rod, 10 mm diameter, 400 mm long, Al 6061-T6, axis along Z (custom shape). Pinned both ends: the bottom centre point is fixed, the top centre point is only free to move along Z, and one extra point stops spin about the axis; 1000 N compression is applied on the top face. Buckling analysis, so the first load factor is the safety factor. Hand check: Euler pinned-pinned column, using the square section with the same second moment of area as the 10 mm circle (8.76 x 8.76 mm).

```python
from build123d import *
from engagent.cad import params, save
P = params(diameter=10.0, length=400.0)
part = Pos(P.diameter / 2, P.diameter / 2, P.length / 2) * Cylinder(P.diameter / 2, P.length)
save(part)
```
```bash
ea make geometry.py --name "pinned rod"
ea analyze last -m al_6061_t6 -a buckling --fix point:5,5,0 --slide point:5,5,400 x --slide point:5,5,400 y --slide point:10,5,0 y --force zmax 0,0,-1000 --check "column.euler_buckling L=400 E=69GPa b=8.76 h=8.76 ends=pinned_pinned"
```

source: Euler-Bernoulli beam, simply supported, first mode: f = (pi / 2 L^2) sqrt(EI / rho A)
request:
Plan: steel bar 500 x 20 x 10 mm (20 wide, 10 thick, lying flat), steel_generic, simply supported at both ends: end faces held vertically (Z) only so they can rotate, plus point constraints for axial and sideways motion. Modal analysis, first bending mode is vertical. Hand check: simply supported beam natural frequency.

```bash
ea make beam length=500 width=20 height=10 --name "supported bar"
ea analyze last -m steel_generic -a modal --slide xmin z --slide xmax z --slide point:0,0,0 x --slide point:0,0,0 y --slide point:500,0,0 y --check "beam.natural_frequency L=500 E=210GPa b=20 h=10 density=7850 ends=simply_supported"
```

source: Incropera 3.1, plane wall with fixed temperature and convection (series resistances)
request:
Plan: model the wall as a 5 mm thick PETG slab (50 x 50 mm patch), inside face (zmin) held at 60 C, outside face (zmax) cooled by air at 20 C with h = 10. Steady thermal analysis. Hand check: wall conduction plus convection, using k = 0.2 W/mK, a typical PETG value that I assumed (not supplied by you); the tool uses its own library value in the FEA.

```bash
ea make plate length=50 width=50 thickness=5 --name "petg wall"
ea analyze last -m petg -a thermal --temp zmin 60 --convect zmax 10 20 --check "thermal.wall_conduction_convection k=0.2 L=5 h=10 T_fixed=60 T_ambient=20"
```

source: Energy balance, Q = h A_total (T - T_inf); nearly uniform plate (Bi << 1)
request:
Plan: Al 6061 plate 100 x 100 x 3 mm, 5 W applied over the top face (zmax), convection h = 10 to 20 C air on all six faces, steady thermal. No exact textbook case, so I add a bound: a lumped steady-state estimate (5 W through h x total area 0.0212 m^2, about 23.6 K rise) which the FEA hot spot should meet or slightly exceed. It only checks FEA is on the expected side.

```bash
ea make plate length=100 width=100 thickness=3 --name "heated plate"
ea analyze last -m al_6061_t6 -a thermal --heat zmax 5 --convect xmin+xmax+ymin+ymax+zmin+zmax 10 20 --bound "thermal.lumped_transient h=10 A=0.0212 mass=0.081 cp=896 Q=5 T_ambient=20 t=100000 -> T"
```

source: dimensions as asked; hexagon (not a cylinder) with an M3 clearance hole
request:
Plan: custom hex standoff (no template makes a hex): 5.5 mm across flats, 20 mm long, 3.4 mm M3 clearance hole through. Defaults: PETG, FDM. Note the wall is only about 1 mm at the flats, so it is thin for printing; the print check will say how it fares.

```python
from build123d import *
from engagent.cad import params, save
P = params(across_flats=5.5, length=20.0, hole=3.4)
R = P.across_flats / 1.7320508          # corner radius of the hexagon
part = extrude(Plane.XY * RegularPolygon(R, 6), P.length)
part -= Cylinder(P.hole / 2, P.length * 3)
part = Pos(R, P.across_flats / 2, 0) * part
save(part)
```
```bash
ea make geometry.py --print petg --name "M3 hex standoff"
```
